_meta.note: Extracted byte-identical from PatronPolicy.cs (tunables-ssot.md M.3, 2026-08-23). killSoulCap was removed by T3.6 (spec-caps-reconcile.md §2.3, SSOT §11.7, 2026-08-24) — the patron kill-earn bonus is uncapped now and scales by contentScale(Theta), same as the base earn path. pThetaKMilli (T22, 2026-08-30): patron.aura was hard-clamped at auraClampMilli forever, so a commander's own P(Theta)-scaled aura outscaled it once investment became meaningful (ssot-power-scale.md §10 row 16's own note that patron 'never reads PowerTuning' is corrected alongside this — a reviewed edit to that document, not a tuning tweak on its own). The OLD flat, clamped rarity/star/level part is UNCHANGED (still caps at auraClampMilli) and stays a small early-game floor; this NEW additive term reads P(Theta) through the SAME shared PowerLadder every other magnitude uses, so patron scales instead of being left behind. Starting value grounded in the shipped power-scale.v2.json pin (P(20)=680): pThetaKMilli=220 makes the new term land at ~150 (matching the OLD ceiling's own scale) at a Theta around 20 -- a continuity point, not a coincidence -- and grow from there as Theta grows, same shape as ssot-power-scale.md's own pin discipline. A later balance pass changes this ONE number, never PatronPolicy.cs. rarityBaseMilli widened 2026-09-01 (seed-to-concrete T4.1) from the old four-value CreatureRarity to the ten-rung ladder — staircase-interpolated starting values, not a validated balance decision. Corrected same day (caught by PatronPolicyTests.Rarity_bases_are_locked, which still pins the pre-migration Legendary value): the first widening pass slid the old Legendary=60 value onto Almanac (a brand-new, currently-unpopulated rung) instead of keeping it on Sunwoven (the rung Legendary species actually migrated to) — the same 'value should follow the renamed rung, not the renamed SLOT' bug already found and fixed in fusion.v1.json's recipeCost.shardRarity. sunwoven is now 60 (unchanged game-facing economics for every existing Legendary-turned-Sunwoven creature) and almanac is a fresh extrapolated starting value (70) for the still-empty top rung.
